nodes.name: 01-system-architecture.md
nodes.summary: Layered system architecture diagram for Waggle OS covering the full runtime stack (Tauri shell, Vite React frontend, Fastify sidecar, LiteLLM router, SQLite), request/auth path through the local sidecar, and a package ownership map across the monorepo workspaces.

nodes.name: 02-master-er.md
nodes.summary: Master entity-relationship diagrams covering two storage layers: the per-workspace SQLite memory substrate (FrameStore, KnowledgeGraph, IdentityLayer, AwarenessLayer tables) and the team/cloud PostgreSQL+Drizzle relational layer, with a mapping showing how workspace mind files relate to user and team rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Two ER diagrams are provided — one for the local SQLite mind file and one for the cloud PostgreSQL schema — reflecting the dual-storage architecture of the platform.

nodes.name: 03-chat-turn-sequence.md
nodes.summary: Sequence diagram tracing the end-to-end flow of a single chat turn through Waggle OS, from the frontend UI through the Fastify sidecar, agent loop, LLM routing, and memory recall/storage steps.

nodes.name: 04-feature-api-map.md
nodes.summary: Blueprint mapping every UI app and overlay screen to the corresponding backend API endpoint groups, serving as a rebuild reference that shows which routes each feature surface depends on.

nodes.name: 05-tier-gating.md
nodes.summary: Reference document describing the two-axis tier and trust gating system: the 5 subscription tiers (TRIAL/FREE/PRO/TEAMS/ENTERPRISE) with their capability matrices, tier-gated HTTP routes, and the Normal/Trusted/YOLO autonomy gate combining both axes.
nodes.languageNotes: Captures both the Axis-1 tier gate (subscription plan caps routes) and Axis-2 trust gate (user-granted autonomy level), with worked examples showing how they combine at runtime.

nodes.name: 06-api-domains.md
nodes.summary: Overview of the Fastify server API domain split, cataloging all route domains (workspace, memory, agent, harvest, evolution, marketplace, billing, etc.) as a dependency graph with their auth model and which server handles each.
